metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: VERXEX crystallizes in the hexagonal crystal system with space group P 65. Reported CIF formula moiety: C49 H54 Cl2 Dy3 N6 O22 2+,2(Cl1 1-),0.5(C1 H4 O1),C2 H3 N1,3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.514-3.532 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.50-99.31°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C103H140N14O51Cl8Dy6. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 2 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
